details.presidential_2020: Biden 81,283,501 (51.31%) minus Trump 74,223,975 (46.85%) of 158,429,631 total votes. FEC, Federal Elections 2020, Presidential Popular Vote Summary: https://www.fec.gov/resources/cms-content/documents/federalelections2020.pdf
details.generic_ballot_2022: FiveThirtyEight generic-ballot average for 2022-11-08 (Election Day): Democrats 45.703, Republicans 46.935. Taken from the Wayback Machine capture of 2023-04-27 of generic_ballot_averages.csv (538's live URL now serves an HTML page): https://web.archive.org/web/20230427025737id_/https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/polls/data/generic_ballot_averages.csv . Caveat: the capture postdates the election, so polls added after Election Day may be included; no capture exists between 2022-11-08 and 2022-12-31.
details.congressional_2022: 50 states only: D 51,410,295 (47.645%), R 54,262,607 (50.288%), other 2,230,181, total 107,903,083. Derived from the FEC general-election table by removing the DC, Guam, American Samoa, Northern Mariana Islands and US Virgin Islands delegate races (column positions read from the PDF). The FEC published total including delegates (D 51,628,838, R 54,298,205, other 2,246,001) gives -2.468. FEC, Federal Elections 2022, table '2022 Votes Cast for the U.S. House of Representatives by Party': https://www.fec.gov/resources/cms-content/documents/federalelections2022.pdf
